meta.title: What 178,749 Repair Cafe visits tell us about the things we throw away

edt_01.label: The world is drowning in barely-broken stuff
edt_01.editorial_notes: Open with the e-waste scale, the Postma origin story, and the dataset's headline numbers (178,749 visits, 447 cafes, 25 countries). Lead image should evoke a community repair workshop, ideally with a global / circular feeling.

edt_02.label: Fix rate: 63% — almost identical to the Foundation's own benchmark
edt_02.editorial_notes: Anchor stat (63%) plus the Dutch tilt caveat. Donut chart of outcome mix (fixed/partial/not_fixed). Country composition mentioned in prose, charted in next section's neighbour.

edt_03.label: What's easy, what's hard: a 70-percentage-point gap
edt_03.editorial_notes: Centerpiece visual section. Horizontal bar chart of category fix rates. Optional second small-multiple of easiest vs hardest products if space allows. The textile-vs-screen gap is the headline.

edt_04.label: The movement quadrupled after the pandemic — but the fix rate stayed flat
edt_04.editorial_notes: Dual-axis or layered chart: bars for visits/year, line for fix-rate/year. Note COVID dip and EU Right-to-Repair (April 2024) as a vertical annotation.

edt_05.label: Why things don't get fixed: spare parts, parts, and parts
edt_05.editorial_notes: Failure-reason horizontal bar chart with the three spare-parts buckets visually grouped. Inline mention of the 34.1% combined parts share and the per-category sharpness. Repairability score correlation gets a sentence; not its own chart in this draft.

edt_06.label: Median item is 8 years old, brand fix rates span 50+ points
edt_06.editorial_notes: Brand best/worst lollipop or grouped bar chart (10 best vs 10 worst). Age-at-repair data appears in prose only; no separate chart.

edt_07.label: Is GenAI replacing YouTube as the repair info source? Not yet
edt_07.editorial_notes: Time-series chart of YouTube vs GenAI vs manual mentions per year, 2018-2026. Closes with the carbon multiplier (1,545 t CO2e). Optional closing image conveying the human/AI dimension of repair knowledge.
